thread:
Clare: All-hands in 10. Last-minute agenda change: were moving the product roadmap deep-dive to after the Q&A; keep leadership Q&A to 20 mins. Heads-up: were also testing a new secondary ingest.

Maya: Noted. Two ops asks: 1) please keep the leader updates to 2 slides each, 2) if we swap ingests, post the new URL here.

Jamal: Ill run Q&A handoff. Also, patch cable in the encoder rack just reported flapping during rehearsal. Ops, can we pre-stage the laptop RTMP?

Ravi: On it. Pre-staged laptop RTMP and a hotkey scene in OBS called `fallback_ingest`. If physical cable drops, Ill toggle and paste the new key.

OpsBot: Health check: encoder link flaps (3x in last 5m). Primary pipeline: encoder -> CDN. Fallback: laptop OBS -> rtmp://live.internal/<key>. Retrying encoder link every 15s. Will post failover event.

Clare: Logistics: leadership Q&A at T+12. If we trigger ingest failover, well keep the meeting live and pause recording up to 7 mins to switch. Please surface follow-ups in the pinned Q&A doc and tag owners.

Maya: Pinned Q&A doc: https://docs.internal/all-hands/2026-08-qa  put short follow-ups and tag responsible PMs.

Jamal: Tech note for OBS: add browser source for captions and set z-order so captions sit above slides: use scene order + `setLayer("captions", 1)`.

Ravi: If switch occurs, command Ill run: `obs-cli --set-scene fallback_ingest && obs-cli --start-stream`. Will post timestamp when done.

OpsBot: Event: encoder_retry_failed at 2034567894. Preparing to auto-fail to fallback in 10s if no heartbeat.

Clare: OK team, be ready for a 10s switchover. Jamal, cue leaders at T+11 to keep timings tight. Ill announce if we go to fallback. :warning:

Jamal: Copy. Ill trim intros to fit Q&A window if we lose a minute. :thumbsup:
